headline: Oil Majors Post Strong Earnings on Middle East War Crude Price Spikes
summary: Oil majors reported strong earnings driven by price spikes during the Middle East conflict, with YPF earning $2.503 billion before interest and taxes and Petrobras marking a production record.
why: Sudden increases in global crude oil prices driven by geopolitical conflicts directly expand upstream profit margins for integrated oil and gas producers.

impacts.name: Petroleo Brasileiro SA Petrobras
impacts.why: Higher crude oil prices and increased production volumes boost company revenues and operating earnings.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
